release.name: Drupal
release.description: Follow Drupal routes, services, hooks, plugins and events through your codebase.
release.readme:
Official CodeGraph Drupal extension 0.1.1 preview. Rejects commented/quoted declarations and handles explicit legacy and modern Symfony event argument order. Routes and forms connect to their handlers; services connect to implementations and explicit injections; literal hooks and events connect to declared implementations.

Installing replaces the built-in Drupal resolver for this project. Requires CodeGraph >=1.6.0 <2 with extension support.

Computed identifiers, missing external dependencies, ambiguous classes and unknown entity handlers remain unresolved. Broader Drupal coverage and performance review remain open.
